name: Linked sessions
description: Runs of agent teams on one clock: a lane per session with each subagent under the session that spawned it, and every message and tool call in one list in time order, colored by speaker, tool, file type or any label, a call's whole input and output opened in place.

records.name: call
records.one: one tool call, its tool_use line and its tool_result line

fields.name: time
fields.how: seconds since 1970 in UTC, from ISO 8601 with any offset or epoch milliseconds

fields.name: input
fields.how: its path, command, query or description, a Grep's pattern with its path and flags

fields.name: outcome
fields.from: is_error or isError, and the result's text
fields.how: denied when the text says so, error when flagged, else ok

fields.name: result
fields.how: its first line, a denial's or an error's prefix dropped

fields.name: output
fields.how: the text without its Exit code and agentId lines

fields.name: file type
fields.from: file_path, or a Bash command and its result
fields.how: the first path's extension, test files apart

fields.name: child
fields.from: the Task result's agentId, else the prompt a session got
fields.how: the session the Task call spawned

fields.name: speaker
fields.how: the agent whose transcript holds the call

records.name: message
records.one: one prompt or text of a session

fields.name: kind
fields.how: prompt, result for a session's last text, else text

fields.name: speaker
fields.from: the session's agent and the session that spawned it
fields.how: for a prompt the agent that spawned the session, or user for a lead, else the session's agent

records.name: session
records.one: one transcript, a lead's or a subagent's

fields.name: agent
fields.from: a Task call's subagent_type, else the run's index
fields.how: the subagent's type, else the index's name, else lead

fields.name: parent
fields.from: the Task call that names its agentId or gave its prompt

fields.name: depth
fields.how: sessions above it in its run's tree

accepts.means: the line <n>: a call (its tool_use or its tool_result line) or a message, opened in the list, or in a run's index the run

units.means: one run: its sessions, with the view narrowed to it
one session with its subagents, the view narrowed to them
